# Level X

> Level X (legal name: Level X Consulting LLC) finds where a business loses
> customers between interest and a booked job, then fixes that path with
> practical systems and AI automation. Level X also builds its own apps.
> Serving businesses across the United States, remotely.

Website: https://levelxinc.com
Contact: info@levelxinc.com
Blog: https://levelxinc.com/blog/

Note: this file exists as a plain-English summary of the business. Google has
stated that Google Search ignores llms.txt files. We do not present it as an
AI-visibility tactic.

## What Level X does

- Customer path audits: mapping every step from first contact to booked job and
  identifying where people drop out (response time, forms, phone, follow-up,
  scheduling, no-shows).
- Fix sprints: a fixed-scope paid engagement that implements the fixes —
  intake and booking flows, automated routing and follow-up, reminders,
  CRM setup, reporting.
- AI automation built on n8n and large language models: lead qualification,
  follow-up drafting, inbound triage, call summaries. Built with disclosure,
  rate limits and human handoff, not as a replacement for a person.
- A free AI-powered website check that reviews a site's customer path and
  reports likely leaks. One free check per website.

## Who it is for

Service and retail businesses in the United States that get inquiries and want
more of them to turn into booked, paid work. Best fit for owners willing to run
a paid, fixed-scope sprint rather than an open-ended retainer.

## Apps

- Pausely — a mindfulness app for kids and families. Live on Google Play.
- Prevail (in development) — gentle habit building.
- OffMyMind (in development) — a calm space for couples to stay connected.

## Editorial standard for the Level X blog

Every statistic links to its original source. Posts state when a figure is
vendor-funded, dated, or drawn from a single survey. Widely circulated
statistics that cannot be traced to a real study are deliberately excluded and
sometimes named as unsourced.
